items.title: Government Signs $14M Contract to Extend Electricity to 241 Communities in CRR, URR
items.summary: By Assan Bah  The Government of The Gambia, through the National Water and Electricity Company (NAWEC), on Friday, 25 September 2026, signed a $14 million contract under the Additional Rural Electrification Project to extend electricity to 241 communities in Central River Regi...
